scripts.generate:descendants: npm run build && node cli.mjs generate setting-packs/descendants/default.recipe.json ../integration-artifacts/worldgen/descendants-default.snapshot.json
scripts.diagnose:descendants: npm run build && node cli.mjs diagnose setting-packs/descendants/default.recipe.json
scripts.audit:lore: npm run build && node cli.mjs audit-lore setting-packs/descendants/default.recipe.json
scripts.verify:release: npm run check && npm run test:shard -- 1 3 && npm run test:shard -- 2 3 && npm run test:shard -- 3 3 && npm run generate:descendants && npm run diagnose:descendants && npm run audit:lore
scripts.verify:matrix: npm run verify:matrix:a && npm run verify:matrix:b && npm run verify:matrix:merge
scripts.verify:matrix:a: npm run build && WORLDGEN_MATRIX_COOLDOWN_MS=1500 WORLDGEN_MATRIX_CASES=long-runtime,large-stream,stream-churn,medium-a,medium-b node --expose-gc scripts/run-release-matrix.mjs ../integration-artifacts/worldgen/RELEASE_MATRIX_PART_A.json
scripts.verify:matrix:b: npm run build && WORLDGEN_MATRIX_COOLDOWN_MS=500 WORLDGEN_MATRIX_CASES=small-a,small-b node --expose-gc scripts/run-release-matrix.mjs ../integration-artifacts/worldgen/RELEASE_MATRIX_PART_B.json
